title: CLO International Academic Month Issue 2 (Part 2) Virtual Humans and Digital Fashion
description: The second episode of the official CLO academic monthly video is here! We have specially invited professors from the Willem de Kooning Academy of Art and Design to share the application of CLO in teaching, emphasizing "bidirectional parallelism" to cultivate future talents in the fashion industry with a blend of virtual and real design thinking!
